text:
sam - AE: Heads up: client HelioBank wants a 5-day Private POC. Theyo onprem agents + multi-AZ VPCs. Ask: best connectivity (Privatelink vs transit), TLS inspection interaction, and rough POC cost.

leo - solutions eng: High level: Privatelink = fast to stand up, per-VPC ENIs, lower latency for intra-AZ. Transit/TGW = single routable path, easier to centralize egress & source-IP preservation if they control routing. For quick POC Privatelink usually wins.

anya - netops: Ops notes: Privatelink needs an ENI per AZ for HA. Firewall minimal rules: allow TCP/443 to ENI CIDRs and allow ephemeral ports if using streaming chunking. If they SNAT at edge we lose client IPs; 1:1 NAT or no SNAT preserves src-ip. For TGW handoff we'll want BGP or static route exchange.

morris - security: TLS inspect: if customer terminates TLS for DLP, mutual-TLS breaks and streaming integrity can fail (chunk order/session affinity). Recommend bypass rules for our endpoint CIDRs. We'll provide SOC2 and encryption docs for the questionnaire.

sam - AE: Can we give a compact cost estimate for a 5-day POC with ~2TB egress?

leo - solutions eng: Back-of-envelope (region dependent): Privatelink endpoint ~$0.012/hr per endpoint + data processing ~$0.01/GB. For 2TB (~2000GB) data cost ~ $20. Two AZ endpoints for HA for 5 days: 2 * 24 * 5 * $0.012 =~ $2.9. Transit path may avoid endpoint fees but incur inter-AZ transfer and NAT costs. We'll include a 3-line comparison in the ticket.

anya - netops: Firewall snippet they can paste: 
```
- proto: tcp
  ports: [443]
  dest_cidr: ["10.10.100.0/28","10.10.101.0/28"]
  description: "Allow Redwood Private ENIs"
# preserve-client-ip: ensure no SNAT between client subnets and ENI CIDRs
```
I'll attach exact ENI CIDRs to the support ticket.

morris - security: Also: offer SAML/SCIM details for SSO, and options for audit retention (30/90/365d). If legal needs an encryption spec or KMS flow diagram, ping me.

ops-bot: Support ticket HB-POC-441 created: https://support.redwood.ai/HB-POC-441

sam - AE: Action items: anya -> ENI CIDRs + SNAT examples in ticket; leo -> short cost table; morris -> questionnaire bullets. Target EOD PT. :thumbsup:
